minor.issue: When cancelling a job with status='open', returns 403 ('Only the assigned driver can cancel') instead of spec-required 400 ('Only in-progress jobs can be cancelled'). The accepted_by check runs before the status check in server.py (~line 606-609). Behavior still blocks cancellation, only the HTTP code deviates from spec.

rca of the issue: cancel_job: the three guard clauses run in this order: (1) not-found → 404, (2) accepted_by != current_user.id → 403, (3) status != 'in_progress' → 400. For an OPEN job, step 2 matches (None != driver_id) and short-circuits with 403 before step 3 can return 400. Fix: swap (2) and (3), OR check `status != 'in_progress'` first.
